title: [YSQL][ASH] TSAN test failures because postmaster gets stuck
body:
Jira Link: [DB-12315](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-12315)
### Description

There are a lot of malloc and free calls from signal handlers, which is not async-signal-safe. TSAN attempts to report this, and when ASH is enabled, gets stuck more often than not by stack traces like this
